title: Parse compound duration strings such as 1h30m15s
summary: Parse 200 Go-style duration strings of whole hours, minutes and seconds (1h30m15s, 45m, 90s) and return each total in seconds.
notes: One operation is 200 single-string parses, each with the reading of the library's duration value as whole seconds, plus the loop and the output list, which every adapter has alike.
